scrape() rejects loopback addresses by default SSRF policy

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"http://127.0.0.1:9/"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
